title: Washington Capitals unveil Hometown Remix jerseys featuring the Coupang patch
summary: The Washington Capitals and Fanatics reveal the 2026–27 Hometown Remix uniform inspired by D.C. landmarks. See wear dates, giveaway nights, and where to buy.
body_markdown:
ARLINGTON, Va. – Today, the Washington Capitals, NHL and Fanatics unveiled the club’s Hometown Remix uniform, a special edition look that celebrates the fans, fabric and culture of Washington, D.C. Part of a leaguewide program featuring all 32 clubs, the Capitals’ uniform was designed in collaboration with Fanatics, the League’s on-ice uniform provider, and the NHL and marks the culmination of a two-year development process.


The Capitals will wear their Hometown Remix uniforms 11 times during the 2026-27 season, beginning on Nov. 7, when they host the Florida Panthers at Capital One Arena on Hometown Remix Day presented by The Washington Sun.


Washington Capitals Hometown Remix Jersey


**Wear Dates**


The Capitals will wear their Hometown Remix uniforms on the following dates:


Nov. 7 vs. Florida Panthers
Nov. 25 vs. Philadelphia Flyers
Dec. 1 vs. Vancouver Canucks
Dec. 28 vs. Edmonton Oilers
Jan. 12 vs. Vegas Golden Knights
Jan. 14 vs. Carolina Hurricanes
Feb. 2 vs. Winnipeg Jets
Feb. 23 vs. New York Rangers
March 3 vs. Carolina Hurricanes
March 15 vs. Tampa Bay Lightning
March 23 vs. Detroit Red Wings
To purchase tickets to these games, visit[WashCaps.com/HTRXGames](https://www.nhl.com/capitals/fans/hometown-remix#games) .


**Giveaways and Special Ticket Offers**


In conjunction with select dates that the jersey is being worn, there will be Hometown Remix-themed giveaways or gift with purchase items from special ticket offers at the following games:


Nov. 7 – Rally Towel | Giveaway
Nov. 14 – Reversible Lacrosse Pinny | Special Ticket Offer
Dec. 1 – Beanie | Giveaway
Jan. 12 – Alex Ovechkin Bobblehead courtesy of Vanda Pharmaceuticals | Giveaway
Jan. 14 – Cowboy Hat | Special Ticket Offer
To receive the gift with purchase items through the special ticket offers, visit[WashCaps.com/HTRXOffers](https://www.nhl.com/capitals/fans/hometown-remix#offers) .


**Brand Creative**


Each Hometown Remix uniform was designed around its respective city and fanbase. Design details throughout the collection draw on local landmarks, motifs and culture, grounding each look in something recognizable to fans.


The Capitals’ Hometown Remix creative draws inspiration from the Washington, D.C., region’s natural beauty and iconic architecture. This includes the frozen Chesapeake and Ohio Canal, the scenery of Great Falls, gradient skies and the rich textures of the city’s monuments. A palette of layered blues, rotunda bronze and frost gray brings these influences all together. Signature design elements include the Capitol Dome compass stone, rotunda-inspired typography, water and marble textures, aerial imagery and illustrated landmarks from across the District.


**Jersey Design**


For a team that has built itself up from nothing to being one of the strongest playoff teams in recent years, there’s one word that describes this jersey: monumental. Literally and figuratively, it represents the ability to stand tall, weathering any storm, overcoming insurmountable odds, and honoring our achievements. The Capital Dome front crest is emblazoned with a mix of stars, sticks, and the Statue of Freedom. The sleeves and shoulder yoke carry sublimated marble texturing, echoing the stone of the Capitol, the Lincoln Memorial, and the monuments that define the District. Numbers also draw from the etched, beveled letters on these monuments. The screaming eagle returns on the shoulders, a piece of ever-present history. The hem unites the DMV with cherry blossoms—a visual representation of the optimism of spring (and playoff season) in Washington, D.C. Stand tall Caps fans, this one’s for you.


“We are thrilled to share this amazing jersey with our fans,” said Capitals Senior Vice President of Marketing Amanda Tischler. “The Capitals’ Hometown Remix design draws inspiration from an unforgettable era of Capitals hockey that culminated in the team’s first Stanley Cup Final appearance, while being remixed through a distinctly Washington, D.C., lens. The jersey celebrates the legacy of Capitals hockey while reflecting the city and community that have shaped the team. The result is a jersey that honors where we’ve been while celebrating what makes Capitals hockey uniquely Washington.”


“Few symbols in sports carry the history, pride, and emotional connection of an NHL sweater,” said Brian Jennings, NHL Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Partnerships and Club Strategy Officer. “Hometown Remix builds on that legacy in a fresh and authentic way, celebrating the fans, culture and communities that make each NHL market unique. Together with Fanatics and our Clubs, we’ve created designs that are rooted in local identity and tell a story about the cities and fans they represent. We’re incredibly excited to bring the program to life and see that passion reflected both on the ice and in the stands.”


“Hometown Remix represents the most exciting initiative our team has designed and delivered with our partners since we hit the ice with the NHL in 2024,” said Dom Fillion, Vice President of Creative Design for Fanatics. “What makes this program so special is the collaboration with each club and together leaning into the history, culture, fabric and identity of every city and fan base to make sure these felt as authentic and personal as possible. We can’t wait to see them worn by the teams on the ice and the fans in the stands all season long.”


Tom Wilson, Washington Capitals right wing / forward and alternate captain


**Retail**


Hometown Remix jerseys – both the on-ice Authentic Pro and Premium versions – and a cutting-edge assortment of headwear and men’s and women’s fan gear, including hoodies, tees and brand new fleece and outerwear styles, are available beginning today across the Fanatics network of sites, including[NHLShop.com](http://nhlshop.com/) ,[NHLShop.ca](http://nhlshop.ca/) and[Fanatics.com](http://fanatics.com/) , as well as team stores and the NHL Shop NYC flagship store.


The Team Stores at Capital One Arena and MedStar Capitals Iceplex have the jersey and various Hometown Remix-related apparel options available for purchase now. Additional items will continue to be made available as they are received.


**Coupang Patch**


The jersey also features the Coupang jersey patch. Coupang has its logo featuring its wordmark and a rocket worn on the upper right chest area of the Capitals home and third jerseys. The logo is symbolic of Coupang’s services that offer international customers a selection of millions of items sold by U.S. companies including fresh groceries, consumer electronics and home goods – 99% of which are delivered within a day. Customers in some overseas markets can also order goods by midnight and have it delivered early the next morning. All of this is made possible by Coupang’s investments in advanced fulfillment and logistics technologies and services. The partnership highlights Coupang as an American company that exports and builds economic bridges for U.S. businesses – small, medium, large and agricultural – to sell their products abroad. Coupang serves millions of customers across more than 190 countries and territories. Learn more at[aboutcoupang.com](https://www.aboutcoupang.com/) .


**Hometown Hero Contest**


In honor of the Hometown Remix launch, the Capitals are recognizing fans who make a positive impact on the local community. Capitals fans can nominate an individual making a difference at WashCaps.com/Hero. One Hometown Hero will receive a team-signed Capitals Hometown Remix jersey and four tickets to a Capitals game during the 2026-27 season, where they will participate in the game’s ceremonial puck drop.


**WMATA Metro Car Branding**


From Nov. 9-Dec. 20, the Capitals will bring their Hometown Remix jersey to life across the region by wrapping two WMATA metro rail cars in the jersey’s signature color scheme and logos. The special wraps will celebrate the Capitals’ Hometown Remix identity while bringing the team’s bold new look to fans and commuters throughout the DMV.
